title: How to get $100 (£40 in the UK) when buying your first Starlink with a referral link
seoTitle: How to get $100 on your first Starlink (referral)
description: Starlink has no coupon code: order your first dish through our referral link, pay the exact site price and get $100 in the US or £40 in the UK after two months.
metaDescription: See how to get $100 in the US (£40 in the UK) on your first Starlink order, how the link applies at checkout and how much it covers on monthly bills.
imageAlt: The Starlink Standard 4 X dish and router on a blue background. The cover is about using the referral link.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Starlink has no promo codes: beyond the offers on its site, the referral link is the official way to get a reward on your first subscription, $100 in the US or £40 in the UK. You pay the same price shown on starlink.com and keep the 30-day return window. In the US, $100 covers about two and a half months of the 100 Mbps plan ($38.50/mo on our reading); in the UK, £40 is one full month (£40/mo). Open the link before you order, look for the “Referral Code Applied” notice before you pay, activate the kit and stay active and paid up for two full monthly cycles. The referral cannot be added after the purchase, and it only counts on orders placed on starlink.com, not on marketplaces.

contentSections.heading: Why ordering through the link pays off
paragraphs: If you open starlink.com on your own, the equipment and the monthly price are the same as through the link. The difference is the $100 (or £40) you would leave on the table. The credit does not lower the price of the kit on the day: it lands on your invoice after two full paid monthly cycles.
The numbers below come from reference addresses. At your address, the price, the kit and the terms can be different, and only the order screen shows them.

contentSections.heading: How to use the link, step by step
paragraphs: Open the link from the [Starlink referral page](/en/coupons/starlink) and enter the address where you will use the service.
postParagraphs: Check the notice before you pay. Starlink says the referral has to be on the original order.
bullets: Pick an eligible Residential or Roam plan on the order.
Look for the “Referral Code Applied” notice and check the reward and the total due.
Activate the kit and watch your first invoice. Paying the first month and activating the equipment are part of the referral requirements.

paragraphs: Tick each item on screen before you pay. It takes two minutes and decides whether the credit is on your order.

contentSections.heading: How much it pays and when
paragraphs: On the order we saw in Nevada with our link, Starlink showed $100 for the person who signs up. The person who refers also gets the same amount, in cash or as service credit.

The subscription has to stay active and paid up for two full monthly cycles. The help center says issuance can start from 60 days after activation, depending on the country, the account and the identity check.

The default is credit on your invoice. If your account offers cash, open Referrals on the website in a browser and choose the reward method there. The credit lands on your invoice; it does not lower the price of the kit on the order.
contentSections.emphasis: The reward is released only after two full monthly cycles of an active, paid subscription, as credit on the bill by default, and the person who signs up and the person who referred get the same amount; the amount for your country shows on the order.

contentSections.heading: Does opening the link commit you to anything? The 30-day test
paragraphs: Opening the link commits you to nothing. The plan price, the kit, availability and whether a contract applies only show after you type an address on starlink.com.

After you pay, Starlink gives you 30 days to return the kit, according to the terms on its page. If the dish does not work on your roof, you can cancel and send the hardware back within that window. On the US order, Starlink also notes that if you cancel service at any time, you have to return the rented hardware.

That is why the link comes before the test: the referral only counts on the original order. Someone who tries Starlink without it pays the same on day one and loses the $100 (or £40) if they decide to keep the dish.

contentSections.heading: Who can use it
bullets: The person who signs up has to be a new customer. Current and former customers do not get the reward.
The person who refers has to be an active customer on a Residential or Roam plan. Priority, Enterprise and Commercial plans do not earn the reward.
The reward applies to new Residential and Roam subscriptions.

contentSections.heading: Does Starlink have a coupon code?
paragraphs: The link already carries the referral code to your order, so there is nothing to type. Before you pay, look for the confirmation on the screen.
The program counts orders placed on starlink.com through the link. Purchases from retailers or marketplaces and account transfers are outside the referral.

contentSections.heading: Four mistakes that cost you the credit even after you click
paragraphs: Most lost credits come from one of these four slips.
bullets: Buying the kit from a retailer or marketplace. The program counts only orders placed on starlink.com through the link.

Paying without checking the notice. The referral has to be on the original order and cannot be added afterwards: if the “Referral Code Applied” notice is missing, reopen the link before you pay. If you switch device or browser in the middle of the order, open the link again and check the notice again.
Using the link as a current or former customer. The credit is only for people who subscribe to Starlink for the first time.
Cancelling too early. The credit needs an active, paid-up subscription for two full monthly cycles, and issuance can start from 60 days after activation.

contentSections.heading: What about the Black Friday offer?
paragraphs: The Black Friday discount on service plans and the referral reward are two separate lines to check on the order. See the [Starlink Black Friday math](/en/reviews/starlink-black-friday-deal) and look at the offer for your own address.

On the Nevada order summary for the 100 Mbps plan, Starlink showed $55 minus $16.50 (30%), the rental kit at $349 minus $349 and $20 plus taxes due today. Its FAQ says the monthly price has no fixed duration and that Starlink may update pricing with 30 days’ notice. If the contract is what worries you, read the [Starlink contract, cancellation and refund guide](/en/reviews/starlink-contract-cancel-refund) and [is Starlink worth it](/en/reviews/is-starlink-worth-it).

contentSections.heading: How to track a referral and use your own link
paragraphs: In the Referrals tab of the website or the app, you can follow the status of everyone who signed up through your link. Starlink sends an email when someone places an order. A referral may go through an eligibility check before it produces a reward.

Once you are an active customer on an eligible Residential or Roam plan, you can refer Starlink too, and the person who refers gets the same amount as the new customer. The amount for your country shows on the order of the person who signs up.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Starlink have a discount coupon? No. Starlink has no coupon: through Cecília's referral link, the person who subscribes gets US$ 100 in the US (£ 40 in the UK) after two months of subscription, as credit on the bill, and the person who referred gets the same amount.

How does the Starlink referral work? Place the order on starlink.com through the link. Check that the referral shows as applied, activate the kit and keep the service active and paid for two full monthly cycles.
How much is the Starlink referral worth? On the Nevada order with our link, $100 showed up for the person who signs up. Check the amount on your own order.
When does the Starlink referral reward arrive? The help center says issuance can start from 60 days after activation, if the referral meets the program conditions.
Does the referral work on a retailer or marketplace order? The program requires the purchase to be made directly on starlink.com through the link.
I used Starlink before. Can I use the link? The reward is for people who subscribe to Starlink for the first time.

Does the referral work in other countries? The help center says it works in most countries where Starlink sells, and the amount depends on the country where you sign up. In the US, our link showed $100.
Can I add the referral after I paid? No. Starlink requires the referral to be on the original order, placed on starlink.com through a referral link, before payment.
